customer_reply:
Hi,

Thank you for reaching out. The delay you’re experiencing is a known behavior described in our KB article "Approvals appear in the approver inbox with a delay" (KB-6082). The delay is due to the system’s batch processing schedule. There’s no configuration change that can reduce it further.

If you need approvals to appear immediately, you can consider enabling the “Immediate Approval Notification” feature (if your subscription includes it) or using the API to poll for status changes. For more details, please see the article linked above.

Let us know if you’d like assistance setting that up or if you have any other questions.

Best regards,
Support Team
